label: v6_s2_base_mse_s0_ep380_r2_a1random_a2rl_es0
config_content:
# v6 S2 (docs/v6_instructions.md §3.0 base(MSE) row, docs/v6_experiment_log.md
# §21-28). Identical to config/exp/v5_base_mse.yml except the probe critic is
# v6's reward-conditioned, FiLM-modulated critic (curriculum-trained seed2,
# docs/v6_experiment_log.md §26-27) called with a FIXED r=A-1's true reward
# parameter, instead of v3's plain single-purpose A-1 critic.
#
# Diff vs config/exp/v5_base_mse.yml (1 line):
#   model.name : SuperpositionNetworkProbeQ -> SuperpositionNetworkProbeQV6
# model.config points at config/model/SuperpositionNetworkProbeQV6/default.yml,
# which differs from SuperpositionNetworkProbeQ/default.yml only in
# probe_q.critic_path (v6_rl_critic_seed2_film_norelabel_curriculum.pth) and
# probe_q.mu/sigma (recalibrated for that checkpoint's own r=A1 Q-scale,
# mu=1.9400, sigma=0.5522 -- see docs/v6_experiment_log.md §28 preamble).
# Everything else identical: r3_stay data, scratch (pretrain: ~), freeze
# only probe_critic, 400ep, mse_loss, batch 10, test_interval 10, AdamW,
# lr 1e-3, weight_decay 1e-2, per_params (bias wd=0, vision_encoder wd=1e-3,
# share_lns wd=1e-3).
model:
  name: SuperpositionNetworkProbeQV6
  config: default
  mode: ~
runner: PredictionFeaturePredictionRunner
data:
  name: r3_stay
load_state_dict_strict: False
p_mask_vision: 0.99
train:
  loss_function: mse_loss
  pretrain: ~
  batch_size: 10
  max_epochs: 400
  save_interval: 10
  test_interval: 10
  optimizer: AdamW
  optim_config:
    default:
      lr: 0.001
      weight_decay: 0.01
    freeze:
      - probe_critic
    per_params:
      - name: bias
        args:
          weight_decay: 0.0
      - name: vision_encoder
        args:
          weight_decay: 0.001
      - name: share_lns
        args:
          weight_decay: 0.001
